chapter_seo_title: RMJI Chapter 257: Han Li’s Lucky Trade & the Ghost Spirit Sect’s Invasion Plans
chapter_meta_description: Han Li acquires a rare ancient formula while the Yan Clan discovers the Ghost Spirit Sect’s invasion plans. A secret council debates a marriage alliance as the Six Demonic Sects prepare to strike Yue.
og_title: A Lucky Find and a Looming War
og_description: Han Li trades for a “worthless” formula that could change everything, while the Yan Clan faces a life-or-death choice as the Six Demonic Sects approach.
twitter_title: RMJI 257: A formula worth more than its weight in spirit stones.
twitter_description: Han Li snags a rare beast-nurturing formula while the Yan Clan debates a demonic marriage alliance. The invasion of Yue begins.

lore_anchors.definition: An ancient elixir formula that can promote a spirit beast’s rank advancement over time, but requires extremely rare ingredients, making it a “chicken rib” for most cultivators.
A hidden fortress stronghold of the Yan Clan, protected by concealment formations; mortals who enter are permanently confined.
One of the Six Demonic Sects of Tianluo Nation; specializes in commanding ghosts and demons, poison arts, and shadow techniques.
The six major demonic-path schools of Tianluo Nation; locked translation for this major political faction.
The best material for refining top-grade earth-element magic tools; can even be used for certain undemanding earth-element treasures.
A somewhat cold and eccentric Daoist cultivator; his surface honesty masks a shrewd calculation.
A forbidden dual cultivation technique that the Ghost Spirit Sect proposes their Young Sect Leader practice with Yan’er; its power and cost are still unclear.
The dominant orthodox power in the region, a strategic counterbalance to the Six Demonic Sects; their absence from the crisis raises questions.
